description: This file handles the generation and download of a Purchase Order PDF in the vtiger CRM system. It initializes a PDF controller, loads specific record data, generates a filename, outputs the PDF, and then navigates back in the browser.

classes.name: Vtiger_PurchaseOrderPDFController
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling PDF creation for Purchase Orders, including loading record data and outputting the generated PDF.

methods.name: Vtiger_PurchaseOrderPDFController::__construct
methods.description: Constructor method initializes the purchase order PDF controller.

methods.name: Vtiger_PurchaseOrderPDFController::loadRecord
methods.description: Loads the specific record data into the PDF controller for processing.

methods.name: Vtiger_PurchaseOrderPDFController::Output
methods.description: Outputs the generated PDF to a specified location or stream.
